\begin{example} \end{example}[The $m$-torus] 1. ch12:3.7For $m\geq 2$, the torus $T^m=(S^1)^m$ admits no negatively curved metric. \end{example}
Proof

\sketch Its fundamental group is $\mathbb Z^m$, a noncyclic abelian group, contrary to item 2.
